deviceBearer.description: Scoped server-provisioned nonhuman token, separate from human session

Register.description: Creates CITIZEN membership only; no requested role field. Do not silently truncate passwords.

Provenance.description: Server derives source profile from authenticated credential/run. Hardware tests and field validation are claim statuses, never writable provenance flags.

ObservationInput.description: No source/environment/run/truth fields accepted. Adapter identity supplies trusted environment; bounded scalar events only; waveforms use separately authorized artifact flow.

BatchReceipt.description: Batch is atomic: any schema/ownership/content conflict rejects the batch. Exact event repeats return original IDs.

AssessmentWrite.description: Reviewed assessment, no physical leak-confirmed status. Acoustic candidate requires an eligible qualified estimate, enforced by service.

WorkerBrief.description: Assigned-task-only projection. Does not disclose full topology or citizen contact. Offline lease is UX/cache validity, never new server authorization.

ComplaintWrite.description: No exact infrastructure coordinates, user ID, staff role or leak-confirmed field. Reporter is derived from session. Optional coarse map cell is a later approved UI extension.

CitizenComplaint.description: Citizen-safe projection; no internal incident IDs, topology, technician private notes or other reporters.

UploadTicket.description: Same-origin authenticated upload path, not public object URL. Server assigns storage key; client filenames are ignored.

SimulationParameters.description: Keys additionally validated against selected scenario allow-list; no actual leak position, truth seed or labels. Unknown keys rejected.

RunWrite.description: Observation noise seed is public/reproducible. Separate sealed truth-generation seed is visible only to generator/evaluator, preventing seed-based truth reconstruction by detector contracts.

EvaluationResult.description: Restricted evaluator-only DTO; prohibited from all operational views, streams, detector inputs and normal exports.

RoleWrite.description: EVALUATOR grant uses separately reviewed owner procedure; not accepted by ordinary admin role editor.

IntegrationWrite.description: Reference only; do not send or return provider secrets through ordinary settings APIs.

CredentialView.description: Only issuance response; no logs/stream/cache. Credential environment must match reviewed device profile; hardware/site approval still required.

Error403.description: Permission, CSRF, origin or action denied

Error404.description: Unknown or inaccessible resource; avoid enumeration
